# Beth Hurley Dog Training

> Professional dog training services in Cook County, Illinois specializing in puppy training, obedience, scent work, and behavioral modification using positive reinforcement methods.

Beth Hurley Dog Training offers comprehensive training programs for busy owners in the Cook County, Illinois area. The business is led by certified trainer Beth Hurley and provides both in-home and group class training options, including AKC Canine Good Citizen certification.

## Key Topics

- Puppy Training
- Obedience Classes
- Positive Reinforcement
- Dog Behavior
- Scent Work
- In-Home Training
- Canine Good Citizen (CGC)
- Puppy Socialization
- Separation Anxiety
- Behavioral Training
- Cook County Illinois
- Dog Safety
- Enrichment Activities
- Obedience Commands
- AKC Certification

## Training Services

- [Puppy Package](https://bethhurleydogtraining.com/puppy-package): Comprehensive puppy training package with in-home and day training
- [Canine Good Citizen Class](https://bethhurleydogtraining.com/canine-good-citizen): CGC certification class with obedience and behavioral skills training
- [Scent Work](https://bethhurleydogtraining.com/scent-work): Scent work training service for enrichment and confidence building
